chapter.verse: Note leh Laodikia khuamite-a kipan kei maitang mu ngei lo mi a om khempeuhte in, ki-itna tawh kipawlin Khazih ahi Pasian’ thu thukpi thei-in up khialhna om lo pilna hauhnate tawh dimin, lungsim kihehnep nadingin bang zaha lian kidemna, kidona ka thuak thu note ka hong theisak nuam hi.
Tua Khazih sungah pilna sum, theihna sum a om khempeuh kiseelin om hi.
Kuamah in kheemna kam tawh note hong kheem zawh loh nadingin hih thu ka hong gen hi.

Keima pumpi in note tawh kikhenin ka om hangin, ka lungsim note tawh omkhawm a, note in a ngeina bangin na bawl theihna uh ahi zongin, Khazih sungah upna kipin na om uh ahi zongin ka muh ciangin ka lung a dam hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Khazih Zeisu, Topa-a na san’ khit uh ciangin tua Topa sungah gamta-in, zung kha-in, kilamin omin, kihilhna na ngah khit uh mah bangin upna-ah kipin, hehpihna phatna tawh upna khangin kicingin om un.
Khazih thu zui lo mite’ tangthu leh leitung thungeek zui-in, leitung pilna leh mawkna khempeuh hangin note kuamah in hong sut, hong bawlsiat theih loh nadingin kikem un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ lim tawh a dim khempeuh in Khazih’ pum sungah kilangin a om hi.
Ukna thu leh vangliatna thu a uk Topa sungah note in kicingin na om uh hi.

Khazih’ sungah vunatna hangin ci-le-sa pumpi paaikhia-in, khut tawh kibawl lo vunatna Topa tawh na ngah uh baptaizna hangin, amah tawh na kivui khawm uh hi. Khazih sihna pan a thosak Pasian’ vangliatna na upna uh hangin baptaizna ngahin tua Topa tawh thawhkikna na ngah uh hi.
Mawhna-ah ahi zongin, pumpi vunatna ngah lohna-ah ahi zongin si-in a om note, Khazih tawh kibangin hong hingsak a, eite khialhna khempeuh a hong maisak hi.
Eite lang khatah kilem lo-a a om ngeina tawh kipawl kiciamna lai sumangin, singlamteh tungah khen a, eite kikal sung pan a paaimang hi.
A sangbel vangliatna leh uknate a laksak khit ciangin, kitel takin lak a, singlamteh hangin zawhna pawi a khaam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin annek tuidawn ahi zongin, pawikham ni, kha det ni, Nipi ni tawh kipawl thute ahi zongin, note kuamah in kidongin thu kikhensak kei un.
Tua nate in a nung ciangin a hong piang ding lim hi a, pumpi ahih leh, Khazih ahi hi.

Lutang suang loin, pumpi ci-le-sa tawh kipawl ama lungsim tawh kisathei mawkin, ama theih loh a muh loh thute kantelin lungsim kiniamsakna-ah ahi zongin, vantungmi biakna-ah ahi zongin, nuamsa-a a om mi khat nangawn note lungdamna kisutsak kei un.
Lu tung pan pumpi khempeuh in a guh a taang tawh a kipawlnate hangin thahatna piangin, Pasian’ deihna tawh kituakin a khang thei hi.

Note in leitung thungeek pan Khazih tawh na sikhawm uh ahih leh, bang hangin tua leitungah a om lai bangin na gamta uh hiam? Khatvei zatna tawh a muat pak thei nate ahi, mihing ngeina banga kihilhna leh kikhalna lel ahi—‘Len kei in,’ ‘Ciam kei in,’ Lawng kei in,’ kici thute bang hangin mangin na om uh hiam?
Tua nate khempeuh zatna hangin muat nading a piang ding hi.
Tua bang ngeina in ut thu biakna, lung kiniamsakna, pumpi bawlsiatna tawh kipawl pilna a nei bangin a om hangin, pumpi deihna zuih loh nading, khaam nadingin a kiman’na khat beek a om kei hi.
